notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI covers the main death arc: the dead/alive edge derived from the self entity, Release Spirit (CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST gated on being dead), SMSG_CORPSE_RECLAIM_DELAY armed at arrival and gating reclaim, CMSG_RECLAIM_CORPSE with the streamed corpse object's guid, SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST -> accept/decline via CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE, CMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_ACTIVATE, and durability-loss observation. 8/13 tracked opcodes hit; the two missing ones are player-visible.
